description: Start a browser-approved OpenTrain login for this MCP server (no API key to copy). Returns an approval link and a short code for the person who owns the account, plus a resumable loginId; the polling secret never leaves this machine. Follow with opentrain_auth_login_status. A saved session is used only when nothing outranks it (OPENTRAIN_PERSONAL_API_TOKEN still wins); opentrain_auth_status reports the effective source. Failures return structuredContent.error {code, retryable, remediation}. Use opentrain_register_agent instead only when no human account exists yet.

deviceLabel.description: Label shown on the approval page and in Settings → Connections (defaults to this host name).

lane.description: Requested lane; the person confirms or changes it on the approval page.

scope.description: Space-separated scopes to request; omit for the lane preset chosen on the page.

name: opentrain_auth_login_start
